compiled_state.author: Joe Oakhart
compiled_state.description: Add a bounded re-review cycle cap per ticket (plan review) and per change (code review). Convergence data shows normal work converges in a small number of cycles, so a cap at the tail costs nothing in the common case; beyond the cap an explicit human override is required, preventing runaway review loops. Acceptance: cap enforced on both gates; override path audited; distribution of cycle counts unchanged for normal work.
compiled_state.title: Cap re-review cycles on plan review and code review with explicit override
